title: Mario's Face and Eye Trio Cosmetic Brush Set
descriptionHtml:
✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Vegan

What it is: A limited-edition set of three dual-ended face and eye brushes with matte black handles and a custom nylon case.

Ingredient Callouts: These products are also vegan and cruelty-free.


What Else You Need to Know: These iconic brushes feature a dual-ended design to blend and build like a pro. They’re cruelty-free, made with a custom blend of synthetic and vegan fibers, plus 100 percent FSC-certified birch wood handles.


This Set Contains:

- F3 Dual-Ended Precision Powder Brush (full size)

- F4 Dual-Ended Foundation and Face Brush (full size)

- E6 Dual-Ended Eyeshadow Brush (full size)

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-F3 BRUSH: Multiuse brush that features softly tapered hairs to give you the most flawless blush and highlighter application.
-F4 BRUSH: Allure-awarded brush that features two different applicators to easily blend and build foundation to a smooth, skin-like finish.
-E6 BRUSH: Essential eyeshadow brush with both narrow and dense bristles, ideal for applying, shading, and blending all shadow formulas.
